dataset_policy.dataset_versioning: Freeze questions and reference outputs before each comparison; reuse a version only when its hash is unchanged.
dataset_policy.experiments: One experiment per arm per local run; link every output to its reference example; retain original trace URLs.
dataset_policy.failure_policy: Persist local dataset/results and pending sync status; retry upload without replaying model calls.
dataset_policy.source_uploads: For benchmark-v2 and later, display per-question source excerpts and locations, full answers, all ranked candidates, citations, graph paths, fact coverage, timings, usage and paired differences. Do not upload PDF binaries, embeddings, credentials or raw provider payloads.
dataset_policy.authorization: 2026-11-15 用户要求本轮 40 道题的每题详细信息均显示在数据集中；旧 v1 保留原展示。

latency_boundary: retrieval compute measured around production methods, excludes audit stage uploads and shared cloud embedding batch; generation separately timed incl provider tracing
generation_sampling: provider default, same payload configuration in both arms; one sample each; stochastic variance not estimated
